scheme_name: One Time Grant For Media Personality
other_conditions: Applicant must be an accredited or recognized journalist of Assam with a DIPR accredited/recognized card, including freelancers from print, electronic and news agencies
Applicant must have at least fifteen years of experience in journalism
Applicant must not have been convicted of any criminal offense, punished by any court of law, or reprimanded by the Press Council of India for misconduct or ethical violations
Canvassing for the grant in any form will disqualify the candidature and may lead to debarment
benefits_summary: One‑time grant of ₹5,00,000 to each of 20 journalists per year.
